info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Settlement Process-spec
info.description: The Settlement Process Management API is designed to facilitate the initiation of settlement processes within a payment system. This endpoint allows users to process a specific settlement identified by its unique ID. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers managing payment settlements. The API streamlines settlement operations, ensuring swift and accurate transaction handling, essential for maintaining efficient cash flow and reconciliation processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate the processing of the settlement identified by RES-100045. Upon successful execution, the system will handle the relevant business logic required to process the settlement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the processing of the settlement identified by RES-100045. The content should conform to the specified JSON schema, which outlines the required parameters and their formats. Make sure to provide all necessary details for a successful processing operation.
